parameters.name: Volume Response
parameters.description: Also CC 12, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Bipolar (Center Value = 0) Adjusts the linearity of the Volume Antenna response (concave to convex).

parameters.name: Pitch Response
parameters.description: Also CC 13, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Bipolar (Center Value = 0) Adjusts the linearity of the Pitch Antenna response (concave to convex).

parameters.name: Quantize Amount
parameters.description: Also CC 16, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Determines the level of quantization.

parameters.name: Quantize (ROOT)
parameters.description: Also NRPN 485. Selects the root note (key) of the scale used for quantization.

parameters.name: Quantize Scale
parameters.description: Also NRPN 486. Selects the scale used for quantization.

parameters.name: Register
parameters.description: Also NRPN 475. Octave Offset for the Pitch Antenna.

parameters.name: Filter Cutoff
parameters.description: Also CC 19, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Analog VCF (Oscillator 1 only).

parameters.name: Brightness
parameters.description: Also CC 17, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Analog Harmonic Enhancement (Oscillator 1 only).

parameters.name: Wave
parameters.description: Also CC 18, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Analog Waveshaper (Oscillator 1 only).

parameters.name: Delay Time
parameters.description: Also CC 20, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Adjusts the Delay Time (70ms to 700ms).

parameters.name: Delay Mix
parameters.description: Also CC 21, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Adjusts the Delay Wet/Dry mix.

parameters.name: Delay Feedback
parameters.description: Also CC 22, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Adjusts the Delay Feedback amount.

parameters.name: Pitch Antenna Scan Freq Mod Amount
parameters.description: Also NRPN 472. Bipolar (Center Value = 0) This parameter controls the depth of the PITCH CV signal used to modulate the frequency at which the oscillators' wavetable is scanned.

parameters.name: Pitch Antenna Scan Pos Mod Amount
parameters.description: Also NRPN 473. Bipolar (Center Value = 0) This parameter controls the depth of the PITCH CV signal used to modulate the scan position of the oscillators' wavetable.

parameters.name: Oscillator 1 Mode
parameters.description: Also NRPN 481. Selects the mode for Oscillator 1.

parameters.name: Oscillator 1 Level
parameters.description: Also CC 25, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Selects the level for Oscillator 1.

parameters.name: Oscillator 1 Wavetable
parameters.description: Also NRPN 483. Selects the Wavetable in use for Oscillator 1, when the Oscillator 1 MODE is set to Wavetable (102).

parameters.name: Oscillator 1 Scan Position (Center)
parameters.description: Also NRPN 487. Specifies the starting position for scanning back and forth through the selected Wavetable.

parameters.name: Oscillator 1 Scan Frequency
parameters.description: Also CC 23, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Adjusts the rate for scanning back and forth through the selected Wavetable (0.1 Hz to 100 Hz).

parameters.name: Oscillator 1 Scan Amount (Width)
parameters.description: Also NRPN 489. Sets the width of the Wavetable scanning window (0 to full frame).

parameters.name: Oscillator 2 Beat Frequency
parameters.description: Also NRPN 428. Bipolar (Center Value = 0) Linear offset (-10Hz to +10Hz) for the secondary oscillator frequency relative to the primary.

parameters.name: Oscillator 2 Semitone Offset
parameters.description: Also NRPN 427. Bipolar (Center Value = 0) Musical-pitch offset (-12 semitones to +12 semitones) for the secondary oscillator relative to the primary.

parameters.name: Oscillator 2 Level
parameters.description: Also CC 26, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Specifies the level of Oscillator 2.

parameters.name: Noise Level
parameters.description: Also CC 9, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Specifies the level of the Noise source sent to the Filter of Oscillator 2.

parameters.name: Oscillator 2 Wavetable
parameters.description: Also NRPN 482. Selects the Wavetable in use for Oscillator 2, when the Oscillator 2 MODE is set to Wavetable (102).

parameters.name: Oscillator 2 Scan Position (Center)
parameters.description: Also NRPN 488. Specifies the starting position for scan-ning back and forth through the selected Wavetable.

parameters.name: Oscillator 2 Scan Frequency
parameters.description: Also CC 24, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Adjusts the rate for scanning back and forth through the selected Wavetable (0.1 Hz to 100 Hz).

parameters.name: Oscillator 2 Scan Amount (Width)
parameters.description: Also NRPN 490. Sets the width of the Wavetable scan-ning window (0 to full frame).

parameters.name: Oscillator 2 Filter Offset
parameters.description: Also CC 8, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Sets the Cutoff Frequency of the two-pole State-Variable Filter (SVF) affecting Oscillator 2 and Noise.

parameters.name: Oscillator 2 Filter Mode
parameters.description: Also NRPN 491. Sets the Filter mode of the two-pole State-Variable Filter (SVF) affecting Oscillator 2 and Noise.

parameters.name: Oscillator 2 Filter Resonance (Q)
parameters.description: Also CC 10, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Sets the Resonance Amount of the two-pole State-Variable Filter (SVF) affecting Oscillator 2 and Noise.

parameters.name: Oscillator 2 Filter Enable
parameters.description: Also NRPN 503. Determines whether or not the Oscillator 2 Filter is applied to Oscillator 2 and the Noise Source.

parameters.name: Oscillator 1 Pitch Filter Tracking Amount
parameters.description: Also CC 2, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Bipolar (Center Value/MSB 64 = 0) Determines how much the Pitch Antenna value changes the Cutoff Frequency of the Oscillator 1 Filter.

parameters.name: Oscillator 2 Pitch Filter Tracking Amount
parameters.description: Also CC 3, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Bipolar (Center Value/MSB 64 = 0) Determines how much the Pitch Antenna value changes the Cutoff Frequency of the Oscillator 2 Filter.

parameters.name: Oscillator 1 Volume Filter Tracking Amount
parameters.description: Also CC 4, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Bipolar (Center Value/ MSB 64 = 0) Determines how much the Volume Antenna value changes the Cut-off Frequency of the Oscillator 1 Filter.

parameters.name: Oscillator 2 Filter Tracking Amount
parameters.description: Also CC 5, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Bipolar (Center Value/ MSB 64 = 0) Determines how much the Volume Antenna value changes the Cut-off Frequency of the Oscillator 2 Filter.

parameters.name: Note Number Mode
parameters.description: Also NRPN 510. Determines wheth-er MIDI pitch control messages will be sent via Fixed mode or Chromatic mode.

parameters.name: MIDI Pitch Out Enable
parameters.description: Also NRPN 508. Determines whether or not MIDI Pitch data corresponding with Volume and Pitch an-tenna CV will be sent.

parameters.name: Fixed Mode MIDI Note Number
parameters.description: Also NRPN 509. Set the base Note Number that will be used for MIDI Note On when in Pitch Move mode.

parameters.name: Volume CV Output Scale
parameters.description: Also CC 30, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Bipolar (Center Value = 0) Attenuates the max CV Output level available to the selected Volume CV Out Range. Negative values invert the output range.

parameters.name: Volume CV Output Range
parameters.description: Also NRPN 504. Sets the CV range found at the VOLUME OUT jack.

parameters.name: Pitch CV Output Range
parameters.description: Also NRPN 493. Sets the voltage range for the PITCH OUT CV jack.

parameters.name: Pitch CV Out Quantize
parameters.description: Also NRPN 495. Selects if the value of the PITCH OUT CV jack is determined before or after any quantization.

parameters.name: CV In Scale
parameters.description: Also CC 14, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Scales the voltage of the CV IN jack plus/minus 100%; Center value = 0 out-put.

parameters.name: CV In Offset
parameters.description: Also CC 29, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Bipolar (Center Value = 0) This parameter pro-vides an offset voltage that is added or sub-tracted from the CV Input Range.

parameters.name: CV In Range
parameters.description: Also NRPN 492. Sets the expected voltage range of the CV IN jack.

parameters.name: Mute Mode
parameters.description: Also NRPN 507. Determines whether the panel MUTE jack toggles MUTE on/ off with successive presses (latching), or mutes on press/ unmutes on release (momentary).

parameters.name: MIDI Note On Thresh-old
parameters.description: Also CC 111, the MSB of it, 0 - 127. Determines the Volume Antenna CV level at which a Note On/Off message will be sent. Note will remain On as long as Volume Antenna CV is above threshold, and will remain Off as long as Volume Antenna CV is below threshold.

parameters.name: Volume Antenna Control Mode
parameters.description: Also NRPN 513. Determines whether the Volume Antenna is active, active with automute enabled, or disabled with external MIDI CC# 7 control of Volume enabled.

engine.description: Moog Claravox Centennial theremin: the MIDI parameter tables of its user guide, the 14-bit settings on their NRPNs and the rest on their CCs.

Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/moog/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/moog/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
No identity check: the manual prints no Device Inquiry reply.
The Quantize (ROOT) names are C♯ (D♭) and so on: the guide's ♯ and ♭ are in a font whose signs the PDF's text leaves out (`C (D )`), and are restored here.
Every row prints a CC and an NRPN. A range of 0 - 16383 is sent on the NRPN, as one 14-bit value; the rest, 0 - 127 or named values, on the CC.
Each NRPN is sent with its number split as MIDI splits one (MSB n / 128, LSB n % 128) and its value as one 14-bit number, data entry MSB on CC 6 then LSB on CC 38.
